chart_indexing: all order-fourteen principal pivot sets, equivalently their two free indices
frame_formula: F_I=[-B_I^(-1) C_I; I_2] in pivot/free order

mutation_control.mutation: each of the 120 single-coordinate shifts by one, and the decomposable vector (1, 0, ..., 0), compared with the Plucker coordinates of an independently computed nullspace

scope: exact principal-Pfaffian frames and kernel-Gauss coordinates on the retained 66-point integer grid; not a global atlas, moduli classification, transition-function classification, or bundle class
transition_formula: on U_I intersect U_J, T_IJ is F_J restricted to the I-free rows and F_I T_IJ=F_J
